# BAS-IP — справочник по API (актуальные версии)

Документ описывает **текущие** (current) версии HTTP API оборудования BAS-IP.
Всего семейств: **7**, операций: **771**.

Источник: спецификации OpenAPI, опубликованные на `developers.bas-ip.com`.

## Содержание

- [android-monitors](#android-monitors) — 77 операций
- [android-panels](#android-panels) — 230 операций
- [camdroid-lift-controller](#camdroid-lift-controller) — 33 операций
- [camdroid-monitors](#camdroid-monitors) — 66 операций
- [camdroid-panels](#camdroid-panels) — 145 операций
- [door-controller](#door-controller) — 78 операций
- [ingenic-mips-panels](#ingenic-mips-panels) — 142 операций

> Условные обозначения: вложенные поля через `.`, элементы массива через `[]`.
> Авторизация — HTTP Bearer (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`), если не указано иное.

#### `PUT` `/advanced/emergency/{emergency-id}/settings`

Update settings for the emergency alarm.

If the alarm with the specified ID does not exist,

A maximum of 5 emergency alarms can be configured.

#### `PUT` `/advanced/emergency/{emergency-id}/sound`

Upload a WAV audio file for the emergency alarm.

If the alarm with the specified ID does not exist,
it will be created automatically.

A maximum of 5 emergency alarms can be configured.

Requirements:
- The multipart/form-data request must contain exactly one part named `file`.
- Additional multipart parts are not allowed.
- WAV format only.
- Maximum file size is 1 MB.

*Теги: `advanced` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

#### `GET` `/advanced/standby`

Returns standby settings.

Standby mode is a splash screen displayed when the device is inactive.

When standby mode is enabled, one of three display modes can be selected:
- `ip_cam_mode`
- `photo_frame`
- `clock`

`ip_cam_mode` supports three sub-modes:
- `single`
- `tour`
- `quad_splitter`

Note: `quad_splitter` is not available on the aq07la device.

*Теги: `advanced` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Ответы**

| Код | Описание | Тип тела |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | OK | application/json |
| `401` | Unauthorized request. Log In | application/json |

<details><summary>Схема ответа 200 · application/json — OK</summary>

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enable` | boolean | да | Determines whether the device will show splash screen after timeout | False |
| `mode` | string enum(ip_cam_mode, photo_frame, clock) | да | Splash screen mode | clock |
| `ip_cam_mode` | object | да | IP cam mode options |  |
| `ip_cam_mode.mode` | string | да | IP cam mode | single |
| `ip_cam_mode.single` | object | да | This model provides camera information used for configuring splash screen |  |
| `ip_cam_mode.single.name` | string | да | Camera name | Cam1 |
| `ip_cam_mode.single.url` | string | да | Camera RTSP url | rtsp://192.168.1.111:554/media/video1 |
| `ip_cam_mode.single.uuid` | string | нет | Unique identifier | 91c615e3-1040-4815-8ecb-039a18b756b5 |
| `ip_cam_mode.tour` | object | да | IP cam tour mode settings |  |
| `ip_cam_mode.tour.ip_cams` | array<object> | нет | The model describes the list of cameras used in 'Tour' splash screen |  |
| `ip_cam_mode.tour.ip_cams[].name` | string | да | Camera name | Cam1 |
| `ip_cam_mode.tour.ip_cams[].url` | string | да | Camera RTSP url | rtsp://192.168.1.111:554/media/video1 |

| `ip_cam_mode.quad_splitter` | object | да | This model provides information used for configuring 'Quad' splash screen  This option is disabled in AQ-07LA model  |  |

#### `POST` `/system/concierge/forward`

Configures the multiple-concierge call mode feature. Enabling this feature disables the SOS button feature if it is active.

*Теги: `concierge` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Тело запроса** (опционально)

Тип: `application/json`

> This model describes concierge forward mode.  Device will call on concierge from 1 to 8 with provided `timeout` if enabled 

<details><summary>Схема тела запроса · application/json</summary>

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enable` | boolean | да | Determines whether the feature is enabled | True |
| `timeout` | integer | да | Determines the time to call the concierge | 25 |

</details>

**Ответы**

| Код | Описание | Тип тела |
|---|---|---|

### android-monitors / intercom

#### `GET` `/intercom/advanced`

Returns the current state of advanced intercom call options:

- `camera` — enables/disables the device camera during calls.
- `auto_pickup` — automatically answers incoming calls.
- `auto_answer` — plays a "nobody home" message and records a message if no one answers after 30 seconds.
- `protect_unlock` — shows a login dialog to confirm identity before the door lock can be opened during a call.
- `auto_hung_up_after_dtmf` — automatically ends the call after the door is opened via DTMF.
- `hooter` — enables/disables the external speaker (hooter) and sets the delay before it activates on an incoming call.

*Теги: `intercom` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

| `auto_pickup` | boolean | нет | Automatic answer on incoming call if enabled | False |
| `auto_hung_up_after_dtmf` | boolean | нет | Determines whether the feature is enabled | False |
| `auto_answer` | boolean | нет | Determines whether the feature is enabled | False |
| `protect_unlock` | boolean | да | The system will ask for the user password when trying to open the lock if enabled  | False |
| `hooter` | object | нет | Supply + 12V to monitor alarm output after the specified time after receiving an incoming call  |  |

The first key is always enabled and uses its default value unless `default_value` is set to `false`, in which case the `value` field is used. The second key can be disabled.

| `first_key.value` | string | нет | Custom DTMF value | * |

#### `GET` `/network/sipnet`

Returns the current network interface configuration used for SIP traffic.

Available `network_mode` values:
  - `ethernet`: Bound only to Ethernet.
  - `wifi`: Bound only to Wi-Fi.
  - `dual`: Ethernet and Wi-Fi are both usable at once. SIP registration and SIP calls go via Wi-Fi; multicast calls use whichever network the responding peer is on.
  - `dual_gateway`: Same as `dual`, and the device's Wi-Fi also acts as a gateway.

DNS resolution is always performed via Wi-Fi, regardless of `network_mode`.

*Теги: `intercom, network` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Ответы**

| Код | Описание | Тип тела |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | OK | application/json |
| `401` | Unauthorized request. Log In | application/json |

<details><summary>Схема ответа 200 · application/json — OK</summary>

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `network_mode` | string enum(ethernet, wifi, dual, dual_gateway) | да | Network interface used for SIP registration, multicast, and SIP calls. `ethernet`/`wifi` bind exclusively to that interface; `dual` lets Ethernet and Wi-Fi be used simultaneously (SIP via Wi-Fi, multicast via whichever network the peer responds on); `dual_gateway` is the same as `dual` with the device's Wi-Fi also acting as a gateway. DNS resolution is always performed via Wi-Fi, regardless of this value. | dual |

</details>

<details><summary>Схема ответа 401 · application/json — Unauthorized request. Log In</summary>

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `error` | string | да | Error information | Log In |

</details>

#### `GET` `/network/management/server`

Returns the management server configuration.

If Link is enabled, the server will sync identifiers, access rules, logs, etc.

If realtime logging is enabled, the device will send logs to the server in real time.

If heartbeat is enabled, the device will send a keep-alive to the server every 10 seconds.
When the MQTT protocol is used, heartbeat is enabled by default.

#### `POST` `/network/wifi/connection`

Connects to a Wi-Fi network using the provided SSID and password.
If the connection is not established within 10 seconds, the request fails with a timeout error.

*Теги: `network, wifi` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Тело запроса** (опционально)

Тип: `application/json`

<details><summary>Схема тела запроса · application/json</summary>

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ssid` | string | да | The name of the access point to connect to. Can contain up to 32 ASCII characters or about 16 non-ASCII characters. | My access point |
| `password` | string | нет | The password for the access point. Can contain up to 63 ASCII characters or about 31 non-ASCII characters. | qwerty123456 |

</details>

<details><summary>Пример тела запроса</summary>

```json
{
  "ssid": "wifi0",
  "password": "123456"
}
```

</details>

**Ответы**

| Код | Описание | Тип тела |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | OK | — |
| `400` | - Missed JSON body - Missed network — requested network not found in scan results - Failed to add network — network configuration was rejected by the system - Network authentication failed — wrong password - Failed to create connection by timeout — no connection established within the 10 second timeout | application/json |
| `401` | Unauthorized request. Log In | application/json |
| `404` | This function is only available with Wi-Fi module | — |
| `503` | - Wi-Fi is disabled | application/json |

<details><summary>Схема ответа 400 · application/json — - Missed JSON body - Missed network — requested network not found in scan results - Failed to add network — network configuration was rejected by the system - Network authentication failed — wrong password - Failed to create connection by timeout — no connection established within the 10 second timeout</summary>

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `error` | string | да | Error information | Wrong JSON body |

</details>

<details><summary>Схема ответа 401 · application/json — Unauthorized request. Log In</summary>

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `error` | string | да | Error information | Log In |

</details>

#### `GET` `/security/zone`

Returns the security sensor (zone) settings.

- **No** — zone number.
- **Type** — sensor trigger type:
  - **Normal mode** — activates only when the system is armed and the zone is included in the active scene. Typically used for door and window sensors.
  - **Emergency** / **24 hours** — always active regardless of arming state. Used for flood, gas, smoke, and heat sensors.
- **Mode** — wiring mode of the sensor (`no`, `nc`, `3c`, `bell`).
- **Delay** — delay in seconds before the zone triggers an alarm.
- **Sensor** — sensor icon type shown when the zone is triggered.

*Теги: `security` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Ответы**

| Код | Описание | Тип тела |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | OK | application/json |
| `401` | Unauthorized request. Log In | application/json |

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `zones` | array<object> | да | List of zone settings |  |
| `zones[].zone_id` | integer | нет | Zone number | 0 |
| `zones[].type` | string | нет | Sensor type | normal |
| `zones[].mode` | string | нет | Sensor mode | no |
| `zones[].delay` | integer | нет | Sensor activation delay in seconds | 15 |
| `zones[].sensor` | string | нет | Sensor name | smoke |
| `types` | array<string> | да | Available sensor types |  |
| `modes` | array<string> | да | Available sensor modes |  |
| `delays` | array<integer> | да | Available sensor delays |  |
| `sensors` | array<string> | да | List of available sensors |  |

</details>

#### `GET` `/access/general/facerecognition`

Get face recognition settings. This feature is available on devices with face recognition.

Different settings for AA/BI panels are available:
- For AA panels it's possible to enable/disable face recognition autostart when motion is detected.
- For BI panels face recognition turns off only during a call and turns on after 10 seconds of inactivity.
- For individual panel face recognition is triggered when motion is detected.

*Теги: `access, admin` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Ответы**

| Код | Описание | Тип тела |
|---|---|---|

| `401` | Unauthorized request. Log In | application/json |

| `similarity` | string enum(low, normal, high) | нет | Similarity level | low |
| `mode` | string enum(software, 3D, antispoofing) | нет | Face recognition mode - software - use only software to recognize face - 3D - also use hardware to recognize face - antispoofing - use 2 models for more secure access | software |
| `enable` | boolean | нет | Feature activation | False |

#### `POST` `/access/general/lock/open/emergency`

Open the locks in emergency mode for a specified duration. The unlock time must be within 
the range [0 - 604800] seconds.                                                             
- If the unlock time is set to **0**, the lock will remain open **indefinitely** until 
explicitly canceled via the endpoint `POST /access/general/lock/close/emergency`.
- If the unlock time is set to a value between 1 and 604800 seconds, the lock will open for 
the specified duration and then close automatically.
- A value of 0 is a **special case** and should be used with caution to avoid unintended 
prolonged access.

*Теги: `access, admin` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Тело запроса** (обязательно)

Тип: `application/json`

> The model describes settings used to open locks in emergency mode

<details><summary>Схема тела запроса · application/json</summary>

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `locks` | array<object> | да | Lock settings after turning on emergency |  |
| `locks[].lock_number` | integer | да | Lock number 0 - all locks, 1 - first lock, 2 - second lock | 1 |
| `locks[].unlock_time` | integer | да | Unlock time in seconds | 10000.0 |

</details>

**Ответы**

| Код | Описание | Тип тела |
|---|---|---|

Response sample: ```json   "error": "Wrong JSON body: no value for `param`" ``` where `param` - is a required field that was not provided - Field was of the wrong type. Response sample: ```json   "error": "Wrong JSON body: value `param` was of the wrong type" ``` where `param` - is a field of the wrong type  - Only 0, 1, 2 indexes available for the lock number - Unlock time should be in range [0, 604800] seconds | application/json |
| `401` | Unauthorized request. Log In | application/json |
| `403` | Administrator rights required. You are currently logged in with different user account. Log In with administrator rights  | application/json |

#### `POST` `/access/general/wiegand`

Configures Wiegand input/output.

Wiegand type. All data received on Wiegand input will be converted to selected type

Wiegand output cannot work simultaneously with BOND lift controller. Disable BOND lift 
controller using `POST /access/lift/zones/settings`.

Wiegand output mode. 

- If 'duplicate' mode selected all data will be sent to Wiegand output. Access will 
be controlled by device. Data will be send ou Wiegand output for selected data types.
- if 'wiegand_control' selected all data will be sent to Wiegand output. Access will 
be controlled by Wiegand output for selected data types (User will see 'processing' 
screen). Other data types will be controlled by device.

To enable 'wiegand_control' mode multifactor/user access mode must be disabled. 'Normal' access
mode must be selected using `POST /access/global/settings`.

When selected `FR` data type to send to Wiegand output, device sends identifier's `link_id` so 
it must contain not empty `link_id` field in `UUID` format.

When selected `QR` data type to send to Wiegand output, QR must contain value in `UUID` format 
(full or short)

`internal_reader_data` data type is not available on AV-08FL.

Feature is available on AV-08FBL and AV-08FL. On other devices use 
`POST /access/external/control` instead.

*Теги: `access, admin` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Тело запроса** (обязательно)

| `in.wiegand.type` | string enum(wiegand_26, wiegand_34, wiegand_42, wiegand_58, wiegand_66, wiegand_130) | да | Wiegand type. All data received on Wiegand input will be converted to selected type  | wiegand_26 |
| `in.wiegand.available_types` | array<string> | нет | The list of available Wiegand types |  |
| `out` | object | да | Wiegand output settings |  |

#### `POST` `/access/user/items/link`

Create/update multiple User Entities with `link_id`.

If entity doesn't exist in system - it will be created. If user with same `link_id` or name already exists - it will be updated.

`has_dublicates` - if user with the same name already exists, `has_dublicates` will be in true condition
`To identify users, use `info` field.

If some of the attached entities do not exist, the user will still be created or updated, 
but the response will include warnings in the `extended_info` field with one or more of the following error codes:
  - `bound_apartment_doesnt_exist` - referenced apartment link_id not found
  - `bound_time_profile_doesnt_exist` - referenced time profile link_id not found
  - `bound_identifier_doesnt_exist` - referenced identifier link_id not found
  - `bound_kone_rule_doesnt_exist` - referenced KONE rule link_id not found

*Теги: `access, admin, link` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Тело запроса** (опционально)

Тип: `application/json`

> This model describes user entity array which used to create/update user entities by link

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list_items` | array<> | да | List of users |  |
| `list_items[].link_id` | string | нет | User Link unique ID | 91c615e3-1040-4815-8ecb-039a18b756b5 |
| `list_items[].identifiers` | object | нет | List of identifiers |  |
| `list_items[].identifiers.link_ids` | array<string> | нет | List of attached identifier Link IDs |  |
| `list_items[].apartments` | object | нет | Apartment info |  |

#### `POST` `/companies`

Creates Company Entity. The `item_uid` value returned in the response can be used as the `company-uid` parameter in next requests:
  * `GET/PUT/DELETE /companies/{company-uid}` to get detailed company information, edit or remove it
  * `POST/DELETE /companies/{company-uid}/apartment/{apartment-uid}` to attach/detach apartment to/from company
  * `POST/DELETE /companies/{company-uid}/logo` to add/remove company's logo. It can be displayed in favorites contacts on main screen
  * `POST/DELETE /companies/{company-uid}/background` to add/remove company's background. It will be displayed during call as a background
  profile photo
- This feature is available only in **AA-14FBIS** panel

*Теги: `admin, company` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

#### `PATCH` `/advanced/notification/button/press/text`

The text displayed on the panel main screen can be customized, for example, concierge number to call or other instructions

- For AA-07 main screen hints looks like:
  * "Call:  RoomNo+#"
  * "Center:  0000+#"
  * "Unlock:  #+PSW+#"
  * "Cancel:  Press *"
  * "Address book:  Press &#8597;"
  * "Press * twice to start face recognition"

- For AA-12FB with different buttons main screen hints looks like:
  * "Call:  Apartment № -> /s3"
  * "Concierge:  Press /s2"
  * "Unlock:  /s3 -> Password -> /s3"
  * "Cancel:  Press /s1"
  * "Address book:  Press /s4 or /s5"
  * "Press /s1 twice to recognize face/QR code"

where `/s1` - cancel button (x), `/s2` - concierge/info button, `/s3` - call button, `/s4` and `/s5` - arrows up and down

- For AA-14FB endpoint is not available

*Теги: `advanced, manager` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

#### `POST` `/advanced/rtsp/feed`

The function of viewing additional IP cameras during a call (up to 4 streams).

This feature is available for v4 monitors and any other SIP devices with a keyboard.

During a call, it is possible to switch between streams by pressing keys from 1 to 5 in the monitor menu.

Key "1" corresponds to the stream of the outdoor panel, keys from "2" to "5" - to additionally added streams (transmission is carried out by DTMF RFC2833).

*Теги: `advanced, manager` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

### android-panels / apartment

#### `POST` `/apartment`

Creates Apartment Entity. The `uid` value returned in the response can be used as the `apartment-uid` parameter in next requests:
  * `GET /apartment/item/{apartment-uid}` to get detailed apartment information
  * `POST /apartment/item/{apartment-uid}/identifier/{identifier-uid}` to attach identifier to apartment
  * `POST /apartment/item/{apartment-uid}/photo` to add or update apartment's image
  profile photo

*Теги: `apartment, admin` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Тело запроса** (обязательно)

Тип: `application/json`

> Apartment entity, used for apartment book and association of identifiers (cards, codes etc.) with the owner  link_id parameter doesn't set by default and must be set from the server side

<details><summary>Схема тела запроса · application/json</summary>

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `apartment_address` | object | да | Logical address - an entity defines the device/user address in the address hierarchy and is used during a call, issuing identifiers, creating call forwarding rules etc. |  |
| `apartment_address.building` | integer | нет | Building number | 1 |

#### `GET` `/apartment/book`

Get apartment phone book feature status.
* When feature enabled, apartment books accessible in GUI by arrows buttons pressing
* This feature is **completely disabled in BI-panels and individual panels**
* `filter_mode` - contacts filtering/sorting mode of the apartment phone book: `by_name` or `by_address`
* `open_when_digit_typed` - determines whether the apartment phone book automatically opens as soon as a digit is typed on the panel keypad
* Both `filter_mode` and `open_when_digit_typed` are only returned on devices with a 4' display. They are not returned on devices with a 10' display (**AA-14**)

#### `POST` `/apartment/routes/backup`

- Imports all apartment route image files from zip archive. The device optimizes the images. The approximate optimization time is 1s for 1 image.
- Image name format regex: `^route-[1-9]d{0,3}-d{1,2}-(d|[1-8]d|9[0-8])-d{1,2}.(webp|png|jpg|jpeg)$`
- Supported image formats: `webp, png, jpg, jpeg`   
- Required image formats are **webp, png, jpg, jpeg**, size - **600x1024 px**     
- This feature is available only in **AA-14FB** panel

*Теги: `apartment, admin` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

### android-panels / auth

#### `POST` `/login`

Authenticate user credentials and return access token.

**Security Features:**
- Rate limiting (5 attempts per IP, then after increasing delay 60s, 180s, 10min, 30min, 1h, 3h)
- Password validation
- Account lockout after failed attempts

*Теги: `auth` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Тело запроса** (обязательно)

Тип: `application/json`

> Object containing credentials required for login to device

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | string enum(admin, manager) | да | The user name for login | admin |
| `password` | string | да | MD5 hash of the complex password for login (e. g. MySecure123!=300a31fbdc6f3ff4fb27625c2ed49fdc) | 300a31fbdc6f3ff4fb27625c2ed49fdc |

</details>

**Ответы**

| Код | Описание | Тип тела |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Login successful | application/json |
| `400` | Validation error or required fields are not provided | application/json |
| `429` | Too Many Requests - Rate limit exceeded | application/json |

|---|---|---|---|---|

| `account_type` | string enum(manager, admin) | да | Login account type | admin |

</details>

</details>

#### `POST` `/login/change`

Setup new secure password.\nPassword Requirements:\nYour password must be between 8 and 32 characters long and include all of the following:\n  * At least one lowercase letter (a-z)\n  * At least one uppercase letter (A-Z)\n  * At least one number (0-9)\n  * At least one special character from this set: ! ; * ( ) _ - + . , $ & \" \u2116 % : | @ ^\n  * The password can only contain letters, numbers, and the special characters listed above. No spaces or other symbols are allowed.\nExamples of valid passwords:\n  * MyPassword123!\n  * Secure_Pass$42\n  * Hello@@@World912\nExamples of invalid passwords:\n  * 123456 \n  * password123 (missing uppercase and special character)\n  * PASSWORD123! (missing lowercase)\n  * MyPassword! (missing number)\n  * My Password123! (contains space, which isn't allowed)\n

#### `POST` `/forward/item/{forward-uid}`

- Create/Update forward rule. Forward incoming call from logic number (`apartment_id`) to SIP numbers at once or sequentially. Forwarding will work if SIP is configured and enabled with `POST /device/sip/settings` and `POST /device/sip/enable`.
- If there is already forward rule with same `forward_number` it will be updated
- Available forward number patterns:
  * `d+` - digits only, for example, `101`
  * `^sip:([0-9A-Za-z+-_]*@)((((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4})|([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*)((.([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*))+))$` - full SIP URI, for example, `sip:100@sip.bas-ip.com` or `sip:name@192.168.1.2`
  * `^sip:(((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4})$` - SIP URI without name and host, for example `sip:192.168.1.2`
  * `^laskomex:d+$` - for devices with hybrid adapter, for example, `laskomex:10`
  * `^vizit:d+$` - another number format for devices with hybrid adapter, for example, `vizit:10`

*Теги: `forward, manager` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Параметры**

| Имя | Где | Обяз. | Тип | Описание |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `forward-uid` | path | да | integer | Forward number for forward scheme |

**Тело запроса** (обязательно)

Тип: `application/json`

> This model represents set of forward numbers that can be used in forward rule. it must contain from 1 to 8 numbers

</details>

#### `POST` `/forward/mode`

Set call forward mode.

It can be used to call via P2P SIP or SIP for given numbers in the forwarding table.
There are two available forward modes:
- **All at once** - the call is made to all numbers simultaneously
- **One by one** - the call is made to the numbers in turn with a delay of 20 seconds

#### `POST` `/system/debug/call/start`

Makes an outgoing call from device
- Use this endpoint for call debug. You can get debug info with `GET /system/call/status`
- Number format:
  * `d+` - digits only, for example, `101`
  * `^sip:([0-9A-Za-z+-_]*@)((((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4})|([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*)((.([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*))+))$` - full SIP URI, for example, `sip:100@sip.bas-ip.com` or `sip:name@192.168.1.2`
  * `^sip:(((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4})$` - SIP URI without name and host, for example `sip:192.168.1.2`

**WARNING: This operation is irreversible and will delete all user data.**

Reacts on incoming "Appoint" broadcast - the lift will arrive at the monitor installation floor when UP button is pressed.</br>Also allows if handle_permit_in_updown_mode enabled:<li>Call lift to the panel floor when using identifier with panel<li>Call lift to the panel floor when the lock is opened during a call between the panel and the monitor<li>Reacts on incoming "Permit" broadcast - the lift will arrive at the monitor installation floor when Permit button is pressed.</li>\| \|call-down\|16\|Mode duplicates the functionality of the lift call buttons on the floor, the relay contacts are connected to the DOWN buttons contacts on the floor or device that replaces them. Reacts on incoming "Appoint" broadcast - the lift will arrive at the monitor installation floor when DOWN button is pressed.</br>Also allows if handle_permit_in_updown_mode enabled:<li>Call lift to the panel floor when using identifier with panel<li>Call lift to the panel floor when the lock is opened during a call between the panel and the monitor<li>Reacts on incoming "Permit" broadcast - the lift will arrive at the monitor installation floor when Permit button is pressed.</li>\| \|call-up-down\|8 up, 8 down\|Mode duplicates the functionality of the lift call buttons on the floor, the relay contacts are connected to the UP and DOWN buttons contacts on the floor or device that replaces them. Reacts on incoming "Appoint" broadcast - the lift will arrive at the monitor installation floor when UP or DOWN button is pressed.</br>Relays 1-8 are connected to the lift call DOWN buttons.</br>Relays 9-16 are connected to the lift call UP buttons.</br>Also allows if handle_permit_in_updown_mode enabled:<li>Call lift to the panel floor when using identifier with panel<li>Call lift to the panel floor when the lock is opened during a call between the panel and the monitor<li>Reacts on incoming "Permit" broadcast - the lift will arrive at the monitor installation floor when Permit button is pressed.</li>\| | access-control-manual |

### camdroid-lift-controller / log

#### `GET` `/log/items`

Get logs list. Available events:
### System
* successful_login_api_call
* incorrect_login_api_call
### Access
* access_granted_by_valid_identifier
* access_denied_by_not_valid_identifier
* access_denied_by_unknown_identifier
* access_granted_by_api_call
* lift_called_to_floor

*Теги: `log` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Параметры**

| Имя | Где | Обяз. | Тип | Описание |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `locale` | query | нет | string enum(en, ru, uk) | Language for localizing logs. Value by default is 'en'  |
| `from` | query | нет | integer | Unix time  |
| `to` | query | нет | integer | Unix time  |
| `limit` | query | да | integer enum(10, 20, 30, 50) | Number of items. Value by default is 10  |
| `page_number` | query | да | integer | Page number  |
| `order_by` | query | нет | string | ### sorting expression: [**field name 1**], [**field name 2**]... <order (asc or desc)> |
| `filter` | query | нет | string | ### Filtering expression:  [**field name**] [**compare operator**] [*value*] <**logical operator**>... \|\|\| \|-\|-\| **field name**\|see the list of available fields in `filter.available_fields[].field_name` **value**\|see the list of available values in `filter.available_fields[].options object`, may be missing  **compare operator**\|see the list of available operators in `filter.available_fields[].compare_operators array`  \|Compare operators\|Description\|Example\| \|-\|-\|-\| eq\|Equal\| name eq 'Sherlock Holmes' gt\|Greater than\| building gt 10 lt\|Less than\| building lt 10 nq\|Not equal\| name nq 'Sherlock Holmes' ge\|Greater than or equal\| floor ge 5 le\|Less than or equal\| floor le 5 \|**Logical operators**\| and\|logical AND\| floor le 10 and floor gt 3 or\|logical OR\| floor le 3 or floor gt 10 not\|logical NOT\|not floor le 3 \|**group operations**\| ()\|group by priority\|(name eq 'Sherlock Holmes' or building eq 221) and floor gt 10 |

**Ответы**

| `401` | Please log in | application/json |

#### `GET` `/network/management/server`

Get management server settings.

If Link is enabled - server will sync identifiers, access rules, logs etc.

If realtime logging is enabled - panel will send the logs in realtime to the server.

If heartbeat is enabled - panel will send keep alive to the server every 10 seconds.
When MQTT protocol is used heartbeat is enabled by default.

| `device_mode` | string enum(access-control-manual, call-any, call-up, call-down, call-up-down) | нет | \|Mode\|Available ports\|Description\| \|-\|-\|-\| \|access-control-manual\|16\|Module duplicates the floor buttons in the lift car and allows them to be activated when using identifiers (RFID, QR etc.)\| \|call-any\|16\|Mode duplicates the functionality of the lift call buttons on the floor, the relay contacts are connected to the UP or DOWN buttons contacts on the floor or device that replaces them.</br>Reacts on incoming "Permit" broadcast - the lift will arrive at the monitor installation floor when Permit button is pressed.</br>Also allows:<li>Call lift to the panel floor when using identifier with panel</li><li>Call lift to the panel floor when the lock is opened during a call between the panel and the monitor</li>\| \|call-up\|16\|Mode duplicates the functionality of the lift call buttons on the floor, the relay contacts are connected to the UP buttons contacts on the floor or device that replaces them. Reacts on incoming "Appoint" broadcast - the lift will arrive at the monitor installation floor when UP button is pressed.</br>Also allows if handle_permit_in_updown_mode enabled:<li>Call lift to the panel floor when using identifier with panel<li>Call lift to the panel floor when the lock is opened during a call between the panel and the monitor<li>Reacts on incoming "Permit" broadcast - the lift will arrive at the monitor installation floor when Permit button is pressed.</li>\| \|call-down\|16\|Mode duplicates the functionality of the lift call buttons on the floor, the relay contacts are connected to the DOWN buttons contacts on the floor or device that replaces them. Reacts on incoming "Appoint" broadcast - the lift will arrive at the monitor installation floor when DOWN button is pressed.</br>Also allows if handle_permit_in_updown_mode enabled:<li>Call lift to the panel floor when using identifier with panel<li>Call lift to the panel floor when the lock is opened during a call between the panel and the monitor<li>Reacts on incoming "Permit" broadcast - the lift will arrive at the monitor installation floor when Permit button is pressed.</li>\| \|call-up-down\|8 up, 8 down\|Mode duplicates the functionality of the lift call buttons on the floor, the relay contacts are connected to the UP and DOWN buttons contacts on the floor or device that replaces them. Reacts on incoming "Appoint" broadcast - the lift will arrive at the monitor installation floor when UP or DOWN button is pressed.</br>Relays 1-8 are connected to the lift call DOWN buttons.</br>Relays 9-16 are connected to the lift call UP buttons.</br>Also allows if handle_permit_in_updown_mode enabled:<li>Call lift to the panel floor when using identifier with panel<li>Call lift to the panel floor when the lock is opened during a call between the panel and the monitor<li>Reacts on incoming "Permit" broadcast - the lift will arrive at the monitor installation floor when Permit button is pressed.</li>\| | access-control-manual |

</details>

#### `PUT` `/contacts/{entityUid}`

You can update contact with the next types:
- `regular` - for monitors, intercom SIP numbers, etc.
- `individual` - for individual panels
- `multi` - for multiapartment panels

Contact number can take two formats:
- `inner protocol`
- `SIP`

For `inner protocol` contact numbers with different type must match different pattern:
- `regular` like [building]-[unit]-[floor]-[apartment], for example '0001-01-11-11'
- `individual` like [building]-[unit]-[floor]-[apartment]-[device number], for example '001-01-11-11-1'
- `multi` like [building]-[unit]-[device number], for example '0001-01-01'

| |regular|individual|multi|
|-|-|-|-|
|building|0001 - 9999|001 - 999|0001 - 9999|
|unit|00 - 99|00 - 99|00 - 99|
|floor|00 - 98|00 - 98| |
|apartment|00 - 99|00 - 99| |
|device| |1 - 9|01 - 99|

For `SIP` contact numbers regex is `sip:[0-9A-Za-z+-_.]+@((((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4})|([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*)(.([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*))+)`, for example `sip:panel@192.168.1.2` or `sip:12488@sip.bas-ip.com`

If you want the device to receive all calls from some numbers without sound, you can add it to the blacklist using the in_black_list property. The call will be displayed in the Records.

If you want the device to immediately receive a call from the specified number use property `auto_answer`.

Two parameters: `auto_answer` and `in_black_list` cannot be `true` at the same time.
Maximum number of contacts - 300

*Теги: `contact` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Параметры**

| Имя | Где | Обяз. | Тип | Описание |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entityUid` | path | да | integer | Unique Identifier for Item |

**Тело запроса** (обязательно)

Тип: `application/json`

> The model describes contact used to add to contact book

|---|---|---|---|---|

| `number` | string | да | There is two format: inner number and SIP number  Inner number for different devices: - `regular` like [building]-[unit]-[floor]-[apartment], for example '0001-01-11-11' - `individual` like [building]-[unit]-[floor]-[apartment]-[device number], for example '001-01-11-11-1' - `multi` like [building]-[unit]-[device number], for example '0001-01-01'  \| \|regular\|individual\|multi\| \|-\|-\|-\|-\| \|building\|0001 - 9999\|001 - 999\|0001 - 9999\| \|unit\|00 - 99\|00 - 99\|00 - 99\| \|floor\|00 - 98\|00 - 98\| \| \|apartment\|00 - 99\|00 - 99\| \| \|device\| \|1 - 9\|01 - 99\|  SIP number format:   sip:[0-9A-Za-z+-_.]+@((((25[0-5]\|2[0-4][0-9]\|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.\|$)){4})\|([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*)(.([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*))+), for example `sip:panel@192.168.1.2` or `sip:12488@sip.bas-ip.com`  | 0001-01-11-11 |

Set external concierge number and feature status. If enabled - device will call to this number instead of system default number. For simultaneous call set queue_timeout = 0, for sequential call set queue_timeout in allowed range. Sequential call is only available for internal protocol.

### camdroid-panels / access

#### `GET` `/access/door/sensor`

Returns info about door sensor options

*Теги: `access` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Ответы**

| Код | Описание | Тип тела |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | OK | application/json |
| `401` | Unauthorized request. Log In | application/json |

<details><summary>Схема ответа 200 · application/json — OK</summary>

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enable` | boolean | да | describes feature status, true - on / false - off | False |
| `repeating_message_delay` | integer | да | Time in seconds after which the panel will send the next message if the sensor is not closed | 60 |
| `repeating_message_enable` | boolean | да | Resending messages if one message is not enough | False |

#### `POST` `/access/general/wiegand`

Configures Wiegand input/output.

Wiegand type. All data received on Wiegand input will be converted to selected type

Wiegand output mode. 

- If 'duplicate' mode selected all data will be sent to Wiegand output. Access will 
be controlled by device. Data will be send ou Wiegand output for selected data types.
- if 'wiegand_control' selected all data will be sent to Wiegand output. Access will 
be controlled by Wiegand output for selected data types (User will see 'processing' 
screen). Other data types will be controlled by device.

When selected `QR` data type to send to Wiegand output, QR must contain value in `UUID` format 
(full or short)

#### `GET` `/advanced/rtsp/feed`

The function of viewing additional IP cameras during a call (up to 4 streams).

This feature is available for v4 monitors and any other SIP devices with a keyboard.

During a call, it is possible to switch between streams by pressing keys from 1 to 5 in the monitor menu.

Key "1" corresponds to the stream of the outdoor panel, keys from "2" to "5" - to additionally added streams (transmission is carried out by DTMF RFC2833).

### camdroid-panels / apartment

#### `POST` `/apartment`

Creates Apartment Entity. The `uid` value returned in the response can be used as the `apartmentUid` parameter in next requests:
  * `GET /apartment/item/{apartmentUid}` to get detailed apartment information
  * `POST /apartment/item/{apartmentUid}/identifier/{identifierUid}` to attach identifier
  to apartment
  * `POST /apartment/item/{apartmentUid}/forward/{forwardUid}` to attach forward rule
  to apartment

*Теги: `apartment` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Тело запроса** (опционально)

Тип: `application/json`

> Apartment entity, used for apartment book and association of identifiers (cards, codes etc.) with the owner  link_id parameter doesn't set by default and must be set from the server side

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `apartment_address.building` | integer | нет | Building number | 1 |
| `apartment_address.unit` | integer | нет | Unit number | 1 |
| `apartment_address.floor` | integer | нет | Floor number | 1 |
| `apartment_address.room` | integer | нет | Room number | 1 |
| `apartment_name` | string | да | Name for the apartment, owner full name or apartment number usually used. Nonempty string without leading and trailing spaces | 221B Baker Street |
| `residents` | object | да | Optional information about tenants |  |
| `residents.count` | integer | нет | The number living in the apartment | 3 |

No spaces or other symbols are allowed.\nExamples of valid passwords:\n  * MyPassword123!\n  * Secure_Pass$42\n  * Hello@@@World912\nExamples of invalid passwords:\n  * 123456\n  * password123 (missing uppercase and special character)\n  * PASSWORD123! #### `POST` `/forward/items/link`

Create/Update multiple call forward rules with link_id
- This endpoint is used by Link management system
- If there is already forward rule with same `forward_number` it will be updated
- Available forward number patterns:
  * `d+` - digits only
  * `^sip:([0-9A-Za-z+-_]*@)((((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4})|([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*)((.([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*))+))$` - full SIP URI, for example, `sip:100@sip.bas-ip.com` or `sip:name@192.168.1.2`
  * `^sip:(((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4})$` - SIP URI without name and host, for example `sip:192.168.1.2`

#### `GET` `/forward/mode`

Get call forward mode.

It can be used to call via P2P SIP or SIP for given numbers in the forwarding table.
There are two available forward modes:
- **All at once** - the call is made to all numbers simultaneously
- **One by one** - the call is made to the numbers in turn with a delay of 20 seconds

#### `GET` `/network/management/server`

Get management server settings.

If Link is enabled - server will sync identifiers, access rules, logs etc.

If realtime logging is enabled - panel will send the logs in realtime to the server.

If heartbeat is enabled - panel will send keep alive to the server every 10 seconds.
When MQTT protocol is used heartbeat is enabled by default.

#### `GET` `/network/management/server`

Get management server settings.

If Link is enabled - server will sync identifiers, access rules, logs etc.

If realtime logging is enabled - device will send the logs in realtime to the server.

If heartbeat is enabled - device will send keep alive to the server every 10 seconds.
When MQTT protocol is used heartbeat is enabled by default.

### ingenic-mips-panels / access

#### `POST` `/access/door/sensor`

Customize door sensor feature.
There are 2 available modes:
- door_sensor
- call_button

*Теги: `access` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Тело запроса** (обязательно)

Тип: `application/json`

<details><summary>Схема тела запроса · application/json</summary>

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enable` | boolean | да | describes feature status, true - on / false - off | False |
| `repeating_message_delay` | integer | да | Time in seconds after which the panel will send the next message if the sensor is not closed | 60 |
| `repeating_message_enable` | boolean | да | Resending messages if one message is not enough | False |
| `opening_delay` | integer | да | Time that the door sensor must be open to start sending alerts | 120 |
| `available_modes` | array<string> | нет | door sensor - the contacts work as contacts of a door sensor, when the contacts are opened after the time specified in the parameter, the panel sends a message that the door has been open for too long  call_button - when the contacts are closed, a call is made to the paired monitor or concierge | ['door_sensor', 'call_button'] |
| `mode` | string enum(door_sensor, call_button) | да | schema describes variants of door access mode | door_sensor |

#### `GET` `/access/general/remote/control/settings`

Get remote access server settings. \n\nIf enabled - panel sends request to remote server and waits for response 10 s. If server doesn\'t respond during timeout panels takes access control itself. If custom server not specified request will be send to `Link`.\n\n1. Device sends post request with application/json body:\n``` \n{\n  "identifier_number": "5a4sd7a5s4d5as3d54asd",\n  "identifier_type": "card"\n}\n``` \n\nidentifier_type can have three types: \'card\', \'input_code\' and \'qr\'\n\n2. Device waits for response with next application/json bodies:\n\n  * Access not handled. Panel should handle access itself:\n    ``` \n    {\n      "handled": false\n    } \n    ```\n\n  * Access not granted:\n    ```\n    {\n      "handled": true,\n      "access": {\n        "granted": false\n      }\n    }\n    ``` \n\n  * Access granted, open first lock:\n\n    ``` \n    {\n      "handled": true,\n      "access": {\n        "granted": true,\n        "lock_number": 1\n      }\n    } \n    ```\n    - where \'lock_number\' (lock to open) may take next values:\n      * 0 - both locks (1 and 2..8 if used SH-42 module)\n      * 1..8 - indexes available for the lock number\n    - also, you can use `GET /access/general/lock/open/remote/accepted/{lockNumber}` to open specific lock

*Теги: `access` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Ответы**

| Код | Описание | Тип тела |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | OK | application/json |
| `401` | Unauthorized request. Log In | application/json |

<details><summary>Схема ответа 200 · application/json — OK</summary>

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | нет | describes feature status, true - on / false - off | False |
| `custom_server_enabled` | boolean | нет | is remote access from custom server enabled, true - on / false - off | True |
| `custom_server_api_url` | string | нет | url | https://bas-ip.com/api/v0/remote/validate |

</details>

<details><summary>Схема ответа 401 · application/json — Unauthorized request. Log In</summary>

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `error` | string | да | error message | Log In |

</details>

#### `GET` `/access/general/wiegand`

Returns Wiegand input and output settings.

Wiegand type. All data received on Wiegand input will be converted to selected type

Wiegand output mode. 

- If 'duplicate' mode selected all data will be sent to Wiegand output. Access will 
be controlled by device. Data will be send ou Wiegand output for selected data types.
- if 'wiegand_control' selected all data will be sent to Wiegand output. Access will 
be controlled by Wiegand output for selected data types (User will see 'processing' 
screen). Other data types will be controlled by device.

#### `POST` `/advanced/rtsp/feed`

The function of viewing additional IP cameras during a call (up to 4 streams).

This feature is available for v4 monitors and any other SIP devices with a keyboard.

During a call, it is possible to switch between streams by pressing keys from 1 to 5 in the monitor menu.

Key "1" corresponds to the stream of the outdoor panel, keys from "2" to "5" - to additionally added streams (transmission is carried out by DTMF RFC2833).

*Теги: `advanced` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Тело запроса** (обязательно)

Тип: `application/json`

### ingenic-mips-panels / apartment

#### `POST` `/apartment`

Creates Apartment Entity. The `uid` value returned in the response can be used as the `apartmentUid` parameter in next requests:
  * `GET /apartment/item/{apartmentUid}` to get detailed apartment information
  * `POST /apartment/item/{apartmentUid}/identifier/{identifierUid}` to attach identifier
  to apartment
  * `POST /apartment/item/{apartmentUid}/forward/{forwardUid}` to attach forward rule
  to apartment

*Теги: `apartment` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Тело запроса** (опционально)

Тип: `application/json`

| `apartment_address.unit` | integer | нет | Unit number | 1 |

| `residents.count` | integer | нет | The number living in the apartment | 3 |

#### `POST` `/forward/items/link`

Create/Update multiple call forward rules with link_id
- This endpoint is used by Link management system
- If there is already forward rule with same `forward_number` it will be updated
- Available forward number patterns:
  * `d+` - digits only
  * `^sip:([0-9A-Za-z+-_]*@)((((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4})|([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*)((.([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*))+))$` - full SIP URI, for example, `sip:100@sip.bas-ip.com` or `sip:name@192.168.1.2`
  * `^sip:(((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4})$` - SIP URI without name and host, for example `sip:192.168.1.2`

#### `POST` `/forward/mode`

Set call forward mode.

It can be used to call via P2P SIP or SIP for given numbers in the forwarding table.
There are two available forward modes:
- **All at once** - the call is made to all numbers simultaneously
- **One by one** - the call is made to the numbers in turn with a delay of 20 seconds

#### `POST` `/network/dst`

Configures DST settings.

DST is a seasonal time change measure where clocks are set ahead of standard time during 
part of the year. When DST starts, clock jumps ahead by 1 hour. In the autumn (fall), the 
period of daylight saving time ends and clocks change back to standard time.

*Теги: `network` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

If Link is enabled - server will sync identifiers, access rules, logs etc.

If realtime logging is enabled - panel will send the logs in realtime to the server.

If heartbeat is enabled - panel will send keep alive to the server every 10 seconds.
When MQTT protocol is used heartbeat is enabled by default.

*Теги: `network, link` · Авторизация: BearerAuth*

**Ответы**

| Код | Описание | Тип тела |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | OK | application/json |
| `401` | Unauthorized request. Log In | application/json |

<details><summary>Схема ответа 200 · application/json — OK</summary>

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `is_enabled` | boolean | да | describes feature status, true - on / false - off | True |
| `protocol` | string enum(http, mqtt) | да | connection protocol that is used to connect to management server (http/mqtt) | mqtt |
| `settings` |  | да | settings applied to connection to management server |  |

</details>

<details><summary>Схема ответа 401 · application/json — Unauthorized request. Log In</summary>

| Поле | Тип | Обяз. | Описание | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `error` | string | да | error message | Log In |

</details>

#### `POST` `/system/debug/call/start`

- Use this endpoint for call debug. You can get debug info with `GET /system/call/status`

  * `d+` - digits only, for example, `101`
  * `^sip:([0-9A-Za-z+-_]*@)((((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4})|([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*)((.([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*))+))$` - full SIP URI, for example, `sip:100@sip.bas-ip.com` or `sip:name@192.168.1.2`
  * `^sip:(((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4})$` - SIP URIwithout name and host, for example `sip:192.168.1.2`
